## Verification

- [ ] Go files are formatted.
- [ ] Relevant constrained tests pass.
- [ ] Fake failure cases are covered or not applicable.
- [ ] Hardware testing is documented, opt-in, and used only if required.
- [ ] Accessibility and JavaScript-disabled behaviour were considered.
- [ ] Pi memory, CPU, disk, and write-rate impact were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and migration/release impact were considered.
- [ ] No credentials, controller state, job output, private infrastructure details, copied manufacturer material, or generated release assets are included.
- [ ] New external actions are pinned to full reviewed commit SHAs and permissions remain least-privilege, or no workflow dependency changed.
